77862-the-curse-of-the-painted-cliffs.title: The Curse Of The Painted Cliffs
77862-the-curse-of-the-painted-cliffs.creator: Unknown
77862-the-curse-of-the-painted-cliffs.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. She was not beautiful, but there was a sweetness, a wistfulness about her face that made men look at her more than once. Her eyes were a misty-gray; almost black in the strong lights, and her brown hair, with its tint of copper, she wore in a long braid.

arxiv-2012-06688.title: Compact 2D Magneto-Optical Trap for Ultracold Atom Setups
arxiv-2012-06688.creator: A.Z. Lam, C. Warner, N. Bigagli, S. Roschinski, W. Yuan, I. Stevenson, S. Will
arxiv-2012-06688.description: Abstract We report on the design, implementation, and performance of a compact two-dimensional magneto-optical trap (2D MOT) for cesium. In a small-volume vacuum chamber, the setup uses cesium dispensers in close proximity to the trapping region of the 2D MOT and operates at low vapor pressures in the 10 − 9 10^{-9} torr range.

arxiv-2012-15334.title: Prime representations in the Hernandez-Leclerc category: classical decompositions Thanks: D.K. was partially funded by the Deutsche Forschungsgemeinschaft (DFG, German Research Foundation) – 446246717.
arxiv-2012-15334.creator: Leon Barth, Deniz Kus
arxiv-2012-15334.description: A 2020 arXiv research paper by Leon Barth, Deniz Kus. We use the dual functional realization of loop algebras to study the prime irreducible objects in the Hernandez-Leclerc category for the quantum affine algebra associated to 𝔰 ​ 𝔩 n + 1 \mathfrak{sl}_{n+1} . When the HL category is realized as a monoidal categorification of a cluster algebra [ 20 , 21 ] , these representations correspond precisely to the cluster variables and the frozen variables are minimal affinizations.

arxiv-2106-07098.title: Security Analysis of Camera-LiDAR Fusion Against Black-Box Attacks on Autonomous Vehicles
arxiv-2106-07098.creator: R. Spencer Hallyburton, Yupei Liu, Yulong Cao, Z. Morley Mao, Miroslav Pajic
arxiv-2106-07098.description: Abstract To enable safe and reliable decision-making, autonomous vehicles (AVs) feed sensor data to perception algorithms to understand the environment. Sensor fusion with multi-frame tracking is becoming increasingly popular for detecting 3D objects. Thus, in this work, we perform an analysis of camera-LiDAR fusion, in the AV context, under LiDAR spoofing attacks.

arxiv-2106-08491.title: Langevin dynamics of heavy quarks in a soft-hard factorized approach
arxiv-2106-08491.creator: Shuang Li, Fei Sun, Wei Xie, Wei Xiong
arxiv-2106-08491.description: Abstract By utilizing a soft-hard factorized model, which combines a thermal perturbative description of soft scatterings and a perturbative QCD-based calculation for hard collisions, we study the energy and temperature dependence of the heavy quark diffusion coefficients in Langevin dynamics. The adjustable parameters are fixed from the comprehensive model-data comparison.

arxiv-2108-07148.title: Data Augmentation and CNN Classification For Automatic COVID-19 Diagnosis From CT-Scan Images On Small Dataset
arxiv-2108-07148.creator: Weijun Tan, Hongwei Guo
arxiv-2108-07148.description: Abstract We present an automatic COVID1-19 diagnosis framework from lung CT images. The focus is on signal processing and classification on small datasets with efforts putting into exploring data preparation and augmentation to improve the generalization capability of the 2D CNN classification models. We propose a unique and effective data augmentation method using multiple Hounsfield Unit (HU) normalization windows.

arxiv-2212-06071.title: 3DSC - A New Dataset of Superconductors Including Crystal Structures
arxiv-2212-06071.creator: Timo Sommer, Roland Willa, Jörg Schmalian, Pascal Friederich
arxiv-2212-06071.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Timo Sommer, Roland Willa, Jörg Schmalian, Pascal Friederich. Data-driven methods, in particular machine learning, can help to speed up the discovery of new materials by finding hidden patterns in existing data and using them to identify promising candidate materials. In the case of superconductors, which are a highly interesting but also a complex class of materials with many relevant applications, the use of data science tools is to date slowed down by a lack of accessible data.

arxiv-2302-00549.title: On Differentiating Symmetric Functions
arxiv-2302-00549.creator: Shaul Zemel
arxiv-2302-00549.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Shaul Zemel. arxiv-2407-13367.title: Douglas-Rachford splitting algorithm for projected solution of quasi variational inequality with non-self constraint map
arxiv-2407-13367.creator: M. Ramazannejad
arxiv-2407-13367.description: Abstract In this paper, we present a Douglas-Rachford splitting algorithm within a Hilbert space framework that yields a projected solution for a quasi-variational inequality. This is achieved under the conditions that the operator associated with the problem is Lipschitz continuous and strongly monotone. The proposed algorithm is based on the interaction between the resolvent operator and the reflected resolvent operator.

arxiv-2412-10548.title: Compact Probe Request Fingerprinting with Asymmetric Pairwise Boosting
arxiv-2412-10548.creator: Giovanni Baccichet, Fabio Palmese, Alessandro E. C. Redondi, Matteo Cesana
arxiv-2412-10548.description: Abstract Probe Requests are Wi-Fi management frames periodically sent by devices during network discovery. Tracking Probe Requests over time offers insights into movement patterns, traffic flows, and behavior trends, which are keys in applications such as urban planning, human mobility analysis, and retail analytics.

arxiv-2505-04504.title: Light propagation through an atomic vapor with non-orthogonal electric field modes Journal: opticajournal Publication type: Research Article
arxiv-2505-04504.creator: Jack D Briscoe, Danielle Pizzey *, Robert M Potvliege, Steven A Wrathmall, and Ifan G Hughes
arxiv-2505-04504.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Jack D Briscoe, Danielle Pizzey *, Robert M Potvliege, Steven A Wrathmall, and Ifan G Hughes. Alkali-metal atomic vapors are the foundation of an ever-growing range of applications, driven by a comprehensive understanding of their interaction with light. In particular, many models have been developed which characterize this interaction for low intensity laser fields. An atomic medium subject to an external magnetic field of arbitrary direction exhibits two electric field modes that, in general, are non-orthogonal.

arxiv-2510-07752.title: DEGS: Deformable Event-based 3D Gaussian Splatting from RGB and Event Stream
arxiv-2510-07752.creator: Junhao He 1♢, Jiaxu Wang 1♢, Jia Li, Mingyuan Sun, Qiang Zhang, Jiahang Cao, Ziyi Zhang, Yi Gu, Jingkai Sun, and Renjing Xu 1†
arxiv-2510-07752.description: Abstract Reconstructing Dynamic 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) from low-framerate RGB videos is challenging. This is because large inter-frame motions will increase the uncertainty of the solution space. For example, one pixel in the first frame might have more choices to reach the corresponding pixel in the second frame.

arxiv-2511-04961.title: Cracking the Code of Arctic Sea Ice: Why Models Fail to Predict Its Retreat?
arxiv-2511-04961.description: Abstract Arctic sea ice is rapidly retreating due to global warming, and emerging evidence suggests that the rate of decline may have been underestimated. A key factor contributing to this underestimation is the coarse resolution of current climate models, which fail to accurately represent eddy–floe interactions, climate extremes, and other critical small-scale processes.

arxiv-2512-24335.title: Backpropagation from KL Projections: Differential and Exact I-Projection Correspondences
arxiv-2512-24335.creator: Manish Krishan Lal
arxiv-2512-24335.description: Abstract We establish two exact correspondences between reverse-mode automatic differentiation (backpropagation evaluated at a fixed forward pass) and compositions of projection maps in Kullback–Leibler (KL) geometry. In both settings, belief-propagation-style message passing enforces agreement and factorization constraints via KL projections. In the first setting, backpropagation arises as the differential of a KL projection map on a delta-lifted factorization.

arxiv-2601-21357.title: Expected Improvement via Gradient Norms
arxiv-2601-21357.creator: Joshua Hang Sai Ip, Georgios Makrygiorgos, Ali Mesbah
arxiv-2601-21357.description: Abstract Bayesian Optimization (BO) is a principled approach for optimizing expensive black-box functions, with Expected Improvement (EI) being one of the most widely used acquisition functions. Despite its empirical success, EI is known to be overly exploitative and can converge to suboptimal stationary points.

europmc-pmc4489356.title: Induction of a common microglia gene expression signature by aging and neurodegenerative conditions: a co-expression meta-analysis.
europmc-pmc4489356.creator: Holtman IR, Raj DD, Miller JA, Schaafsma W, Yin Z, Brouwer N, Wes PD, Möller T, Orre M, Kamphuis W, Hol EM, Boddeke EW, Eggen BJ.
europmc-pmc4489356.description: Introduction Microglia are tissue macrophages of the central nervous system that monitor brain homeostasis and react upon neuronal damage and stress. Aging and neurodegeneration induce a hypersensitive, pro-inflammatory phenotype, referred to as primed microglia. To determine th

europmc-pmc8306262.title: Statins: a repurposed drug to fight cancer.
europmc-pmc8306262.creator: Jiang W, Hu JW, He XR, Jin WL, He XY.
europmc-pmc8306262.description: As competitive HMG-CoA reductase (HMGCR) inhibitors, statins not only reduce cholesterol and improve cardiovascular risk, but also exhibit pleiotropic effects that are independent of their lipid-lowering effects. Among them, the anti-cancer properties of statins have attracted...

pmc-10523074.title: Competition and habitat availability interact to structure arboreal ant communities across scales of ecological organization
pmc-10523074.creator: Benjamin J Adams, Evan M Gora, Matina C Donaldson-Matasci, Elva J H Robinson, Scott Powell
pmc-10523074.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). Understanding how resource limitation and biotic interactions interact across spatial scales is fundamental to explaining the structure of ecological communities. However, empirical studies addressing this issue are often hindered by logistical constraints, especially at local scales. Here, we use a highly tractable arboreal ant study system to explore the interactive effects of resource availability and competition on community structure across three local scales: an individual tree, the nest network created by each colony and the individual ant nest.

pmc-10614648.title: EFFECTS OF LOCAL VIBRATION COMBINED WITH EXTRACORPOREAL SHOCK WAVE THERAPY IN PLANTAR FASCIITIS: A RANDOMIZED CONTROLLED TRIAL
pmc-10614648.creator: HyoJeong ON, JongEun YIM
pmc-10614648.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). ObjectiveTo compare the effects of local vibration combined with extracorporeal shock wave therapy and extracorporeal shock wave therapy alone for plantar fasciitis.MethodsA randomized controlled trial including 34 participants with a mean age of 37.5 years. Participants were randomly allocated to a group treated with extracorporeal shock wave therapy combined with local vibration (ESWT-LV group) or a group treated with extracorporeal shock wave therapy alone (ESWT-alone group). All participants in each group underwent 2 treatment sessions weekly for 5 weeks.

pmc-11353966.title: Optimization and Tradeoff Analysis for Multiple Configurations of Bio-Energy with Carbon Capture and Storage Systems in Brazilian Sugarcane Ethanol Sector
pmc-11353966.creator: Bruno Bunya, César A. R. Sotomonte, Alisson Aparecido Vitoriano Julio, João Luiz Junho Pereira, Túlio Augusto Zucareli de Souza, Matheus Brendon Francisco, Christian J. R. Coronado
pmc-11353966.description: Bio-energy systems with carbon capture and storage (BECCS) will be essential if countries are to meet the gas emission reduction targets established in the 2015 Paris Agreement. This study seeks to carry out a thermodynamic optimization and analysis of a BECCS technology for a typical Brazilian cogeneration plant.

pmc-11413905.title: Herpes Zoster Risk After Total Knee Replacement: a multicenter, propensity-score-matched cohort study in the United States
pmc-11413905.creator: Wen-Chieh Liao, Shao-Wei Lo, Chih-Lung Wu, Sin-Ei Juang, Hui-Chin Chang, Shuo-Yan Gau, Chen-Pi Li
pmc-11413905.description: Background: Total knee replacement (TKR) is a common surgical procedure for osteoarthritis (OA) patients. TKR may increase susceptibility to herpes zoster (HZ) by inducing immunosuppression, surgical stress, and nerve injury. However, limited data exist on the relationship between TKR and HZ.

pmc-11455257.title: 7243 COVID-19 Associated Primary Autoimmune Adrenal Insufficiency: A New Clinical Entity
pmc-11455257.creator: Jessica Naredo Rojas, Beverly Udegbe, Ilan Remba-Shapiro, Sara L Stockman, Lisa B Nachtigall
pmc-11455257.description: Disclosure: J. Naredo Rojas: None. B. Udegbe: None. I. Remba-Shapiro: None. S.L. Stockman: None. L.B. Nachtigall: None. Background: The adrenal glands express angiotensin converting enzyme and transmembrane serine protease 2 receptors for SARS-CoV-2 protein S, facilitating viral entry. Cortisol levels are decreased in COVID-19 infection in correlation with disease severity.

pmc-11520841.title: Study curing of epoxy resin by Isophoronediamine/ Triethylenetetramine and reinforced with montmorillonite and effect on compressive strength
pmc-11520841.creator: Soliman Mehawed Abdellatif Soliman, Mohab Abdelhakim, Magdy Wadid Sabaa
pmc-11520841.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Epoxy is a widely used thermosetting resin recognized for its exceptional performance in adhesives, coatings, and various other applications, attributed to its high tensile strength, stiffness, electrical performance, and chemical resistance. Epoxy-clay nanocomposites are extensively employed across diverse industries. The physical and chemical properties of these nanocomposites are influenced by the processing methods, clay modifiers, and curing agents used during their preparation.

pmc-12641662.title: Medullary Thyroid Carcinoma Without Calcitonin: A Case Linking Ultimobranchial Bodies to Tumor Evolution
pmc-12641662.creator: Ion Prisneac, Abigail I. Wald, Chelsea Bragg, John A. Ozolek
pmc-12641662.description: Medullary thyroid carcinoma (MTC) is a thyroid tumor with neuroendocrine properties purportedly derived from C-cells. The biochemical activity of medullary thyroid carcinoma includes the production of calcitonin and carcinoembryonic antigen, which are sensitive tumor markers, facilitating diagnosis, follow-up, and prognostication.

pmc-12705676.title: In vitro and in silico analysis of anticancer and antioxidant potential of camphor derivatives
pmc-12705676.creator: Evelyn Muñoz-Núñez, Susana Flores, Valentina Silva, Joan Villena, Rut Vergara, Iván Montenegro, Luis Fernandez-Hernandez, Alejandro Madrid
pmc-12705676.description: Structural modification of natural products is a key strategy in drug discovery. In this work, a series of camphor derivatives were synthesized by incorporating heteroaromatic aldehydes, and their anticancer and antioxidant potential was evaluated through an integrated in vitro and in silico approach.

pmc-13122342.title: Detection of Valve Vegetations in Native and Prosthetic Valves using Echocardiographic Radiomics and Deep Learning on Transesophageal Echocardiography Images
pmc-13122342.creator: Farid Esmaely, Pardis Moradnejad, Shabnam Boudagh, Seyed Mohammad Zamani-Aliabadi, Hamid Reza Pasha, Ahmad Bitarafan-Rajabi, Leyla Ansari
pmc-13122342.description: Background: Infective Endocarditis (IE) is a life-threatening condition that requires rapid and accurate diagnosis. Transesophageal Echocardiography (TEE) is the gold standard for detecting valve vegetations; however, its interpretation is highly operator-dependent and particularly challenging in patients with prosthetic valves. Recent advances in artificial intelligence, especially deep learning, offer opportunities to improve diagnostic accuracy and reduce observer variability.

pmc-13125750.title: Acute Infarction Due to Extrinsic Coronary Compression by Left Ventricular Pseudoaneurysm Following Endocarditis Surgery—Case Management
pmc-13125750.creator: Lars Niclauss, Mario Verdugo, Matthaios Papadimitrou Olivgeris, Kirsch Matthias
pmc-13125750.description: Extrinsic coronary compression is rare, difficult to diagnose, and can have serious consequences. A patient who had surgery for aortic valve endocarditis with patch closure of a septal abscess was readmitted for myocardial infarction. CT scan revealed compression of the left main stem due to pseudoaneurysm formation under the patch.

pmc-13183516.title: Design of the MERCURION-IPF trial – intravenous immunoglobulin for the treatment of acute exacerbations of idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis
pmc-13183516.creator: Vasilina Sotiropoulou, Fotios Sampsonas, Eirini Vasarmidi, Katerina Antoniou, Athena Gogali, Konstantinos Kostikas, Fotios Drakopanagiotakis, Paschalis Steiropoulos, George Margaritopoulos, Konstantinos Porpodis, Zoe Daniil, Ioannis Tomos, Ilias Papanikolaou, Vasilios Tzilas, Stelios Loukides, Argyr
pmc-13183516.description: IntroductionDespite their profound clinical impact and high mortality, acute exacerbations of idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis (AE-IPF) still lack any effective or standardized treatment strategies. This manuscript describes the rationale and design of a randomized, multicenter, open-label Phase III clinical trial evaluating the efficacy of intravenous immunoglobulin (IVIG) compared with usual care in hospitalized patients with AE-IPF.

pmc-13294221.title: Design of a green ammonia production process by machine learning
pmc-13294221.creator: Sho Takaoka, Hiromasa Kaneko
pmc-13294221.description: Green ammonia is attracting attention as a way of realizing a decarbonized society. In this study, we designed a green ammonia production process under limited power supply. In conventional process optimization, candidates for the design variables are selected based on the experience of the process engineer and calculation results, and optimization is performed by repeated simulations.

pmc-13314514.title: Triglyceride–glucose related index and its association with coronary heart disease risk in patients with metabolic dysfunction-associated steatotic liver disease: a retrospective analysis based on type 2 diabetes mellitus
pmc-13314514.creator: Xuying Zhao, Yang Hong, Saiyan Bian, Hui Jiao, Xingjian Zhong, Wenkai Ni

pmc-13385448.title: A highly efficient method to differentiate CGRP-expressing peptidergic nociceptors from human induced pluripotent stem cells
pmc-13385448.creator: Galbha Duggal, Xinyu Li, Philippa Pettingill, Tatjana Lalic, Shailesh Kumar Gupta, Christine Flodgaard Høgsbro, Viola Volpato, Caleb Webber, Rory Bowden, Despoina Charou, Kanisa Arunasalam, Marcello Maresca, Ryan Hicks, Satyan Chintawar, M. Zameel Cader

pmc-13584935.title: Metabolic, adipokine (irisin, spexin, visfatin), and ER stress (GRP78) responses in multiparous Brown Swiss cows: a multivariate approach across physiological stages and body condition scores
pmc-13584935.creator: Gökşad Cemil Kotan, Şeyma Aydemir, Bülent Bayraktar
pmc-13584935.description: This study investigated the responses of novel adipokines (irisin, spexin, visfatin), an endoplasmic reticulum (ER) stress marker (GRP78), and traditional metabolic parameters (non-esterified fatty acids (NEFAs), beta-hydroxybutyrate (BHBA), urea, albumin, globulin, total cholesterol) in 360 healthy Brown Swiss dairy cattle.

pmc-13609740.title: Shifting the Redox-Flow Battery Trade-Off with Amine-Crosslinked PVBC Thin-Film Composite Membranes
pmc-13609740.creator: Chiari Van Cauter, Maarten Cools, Yun Li, Ivo F. J. Vankelecom
pmc-13609740.description: Redox flow batteries (RFBs) are an interesting option for long-term energy storage. A well-performing membrane sits at the heart of the electrochemical battery cell and should effectively mitigate crossover of active species while minimizing resistance. However, current commercial membranes are rather expensive and demonstrate sub-optimal performance, leading to an extensive search for alternatives.

pmc-13681821.title: The relationship between sport competition rumination and sport-specific achievement motivation levels among professional athletes in Turkey
pmc-13681821.creator: Mesut Bulut, Metin Yildiz, Mustafa Kizilkoca, Gürkan Tokgöz, Buğra Can
pmc-13681821.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). ObjectiveRumination is a cognitive process characterized by the development of repetitive and difficult-to-control thoughts regarding negative experiences. The aim of this study is to examine the cross-sectional association between sports competition rumination and sport-specific achievement motivation levels among professional athletes actively competing in team sports in Turkey, and to investigate whether these levels differ according to gender, age, sport discipline and sports experience.MethodA total of 657 professional athletes (289 women, 368 men) with a mean age of 21.88 ± 5.53 years participated
